text.title: Threads Growth Worked Examples
text.summary: Worked examples for the rules in 01-core-rules.xml: reply formula in practice, conversation-starter templates, and metrics benchmarks by growth stage, scaling milestones, and the most common Threads growth mistakes.

example.title: Reply that adds perspective and asks
example.note: Reply to a post about shipping fast: "This is so true. I found the same thing when building [X] — the constraint of a hard deadline produced better decisions than open-ended sprints. What made you realize this?"

example.title: Generic agreement
example.note: Reply: "Great point! So insightful. Totally agree." — No perspective added, no question, no reason for the original poster or their audience to engage further.

section.title: Conversation-starter post types

list.item: Hot take: "Unpopular opinion: [bold statement]. Change my mind."
This or that: "[A] or [B]?" (e.g., "Notion or Obsidian?")
Experience: "Raise your hand if you've ever [relatable struggle]"

section.reference: Strip tweet numbering and split Twitter thread into Threads-native conversational posts

list.item: Replies per post: 2-5 = starting, 10-20 = growing, 50+ = established
